title: Database connection pool exhaustion
steps: Confirm active connections and pool wait time.
Check for a recent deploy or long-running query.
Temporarily scale database capacity or application replicas.
Rollback the suspect deploy only after approval.

title: Kubernetes crash loop response
steps: Inspect pod events and the previous container logs.
Check memory limits, recent configuration changes, and dependent services.
Scale only after confirming the failure is not configuration-related.

title: Upstream dependency degradation
steps: Check dependency status and latency dashboards.
Enable the approved fallback or circuit breaker if available.
Reduce non-critical traffic and notify the dependency owner.
